hook.name: HypzFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HypzLaunch ETH/token pools. Charges native ETH fees on buys (from input in beforeSwap) and sells (from ETH output in afterSwap), with the rate scaling between a configurable base and max (both in 1%–6.6%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are accepted.
